title: Coordinate independence of a derivative threshold
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and choose a coordinate $i$. Threshold the discrete derivative of $p$ in direction $i$, assigning $1$ when the derivative is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise. The resulting real-valued sign function is unchanged when coordinate $i$ of its input is replaced by either sign.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the sign cube
